title: Prove the exact joint header law for orthogonal rank-one requests
body:
## Summary

Prove the exact joint first-pivot law for k pairwise orthogonal rank-one projectors sharing a complete GL_m(F_q) header, over every finite field:

```text
J(q,m,k) = (q-1)^k [q^(m-k)(q-1)^k - (-1)^k] / [q^k(q^m-1)]
```

The proof also gives the complete success-count distribution and the exact algebraic header-cover number. One header suffices except for a complete even-dimensional family over F2, where exactly two suffice. Explicit matrix constructors attain the cover number. At q=3,m=2 the joint fraction is 1/6, while each marginal is 7/12, so the guards are dependent.

Claim type: scoped counting proof with finite corroboration. This extends the marginal laws of #4227/#4228; it does not independently audit them. The retained odd-prime normalizer has exactly this rank-one guard. The F2 obstruction extends its guard algebra beyond its executable domain. BIT.md already charges per request; no error in that recurrence is alleged. No actual supplier family, physical cost saving, new kappa or selected-frontier change is claimed.

Only `research/projector-joint-header-density/` is added. Canonical scientific base: `12fa8c5c844be21bfefb38a19503fbd867a11244`, priority revision 7. [Advance claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19080582). The task metadata explicitly records the changed assignment from a proof audit to a new shared-header counting question.

## Evidence

Before: exact single-request fractions leave the joint shared-header law unspecified. After: an equal-fiber scalar-pair proof supplies the joint law, full distribution and sharp cover theorem, with independently generated finite header and scalar-pair counts.

Local CPython 3.12.15 checks pass on macOS arm64:

- 53,432 scalar pairs with scalar product one, checking every prescribed subset and every success-count bin.
- A separate complete-matrix enumeration checks 213,714 invertible headers and every row/column-pair fiber. Executed fields are F2, F3, F4 and F5; F4 uses the polynomial field, not arithmetic modulo four.
- 50 explicit header matrices cover the complete families in dimensions 2 through 12. Six controls distinguish independence, even binary support, omitted zero-product multiplicity, duplicated requests, modulus-four arithmetic and an altered count.
- Both registered normal/optimized checks pass. Timed direct commands took 1.946 and 1.954 seconds; the complete registered replay took 3.717 seconds. These are single check durations, not performance claims.
- The eight-file committed-byte/source-history preflight passes at `5e24dfb5463d540721687d92c369609da5589523`. The declared base is reachable in publication history. Committed export integrity passes; both Git-free direct modes pass with all nine exported files unchanged. Altering a source or the generated receipt is rejected.

From the repository root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/projector-joint-header-density
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/projector-joint-header-density --check-source-history
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -W error -B research/projector-joint-header-density/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -W error -O -B research/projector-joint-header-density/verify.py
```

Any CPython 3.12 executable can replace that local path. Expected scientific marker:

```text
PASS_PROJECTOR_JOINT_HEADER_DENSITY {"controls": 6, "headers": 213714, "scalar_pairs": 53432}
```

`RESULT.json` is generated by the verifier and binds its five package files and both declared live inputs. Receipt generation writes only to a new external path. Source commits, Git blob IDs and SHA256 pins are in `SOURCES.json`.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

The universal claim is the written proof, not a complete multiplication theorem or a proof-kernel result. Orthogonality, rank one, fixed projectors and complete equally weighted headers are essential premises. The prime-power lift corollary is proved by equal fibers; its lifts were not enumerated here. No GL64 scan, higher-rank/nonorthogonal joint classification, actual request-stream binding, physical selection/emission/dispatch/dirty-return cost, stock, fallback repricing, precision, selected cold replay or outer transfer is supplied. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

## Open next questions

1. Determine the joint law for two nonorthogonal rank-one requests. Start with simultaneous-conjugacy types, retaining tr(PQ) and image/kernel intersections.
2. Bind one actual orthogonal producer family and charge the complete shared-header caller, including selection, emission, dispatch, dirty return and stock. The algebraic cover theorem supplies none of those prices.

## Related open work

- #4227, head `3d793eade8de2ba49ec08f8d004c1b2f566a78e6`, supplies exact extreme-rank marginal densities. At q=3,m=2 its rank-one formula gives 7/12, agreeing with this package's k=1 census, checked numerically. The new contribution is the joint law for k >= 2 and exact header cover.
- #4228, head `bb25dcedb5bbbacd3c35359eb6b5488b087bcde6`, supplies all-rank single-request densities. Its rank-one specialization also gives 7/12 at q=3,m=2, checked numerically against this census. This PR does not recount its intermediate ranks or change its recurrence.
- #4215, head `06e7762684bd6342c9b6bd12e8cd414174f09d17`, checks the good-packet algebra at the same normalizer. Its aggregate idempotent corpus is a different quantity from this joint header census; no overlapping aggregate is asserted or re-certified.
- #4235, head `27f1ce44126cb3a841756834649f556de0ce00e9`, constructs a paid pivoted fallback for arbitrary projector packets. This theorem counts the original rank-one first-pivot guards and does not use or reprice that fallback. No shared child invoice is claimed.
- #4194, head `b512fd71e9eb5711d24abaa35978660eeb87f363`, uses rank-one idempotents in a distinct fixed bank-repair alphabet. No joint header fraction or common repair invoice is shared.

Live overlap included fully paginated 340 open/draft PR bodies and 2,980 Discussion records, targeted historical searches, recent account work and refreshed handoff comments immediately before commit. Targeted joint-law phrases found no prior match. Broader closed-history and code-diff coverage is partial. Canonical main was fetched again before submission and remains the scientific base above.

No check failed and no registered obligation remains unrun.

## Merge danger

Two-way door. Blast radius is the isolated new research package and its opt-in replay. Existing sources, credits, invoices and the selected result remain unchanged.
